# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- Action 1: Join the Hegemonic Axis (Bloc A)
oe_end_act_join_hegemon_bloc = {
	type = situation
	show_message = no
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = no
			NOT = { oe_end_is_bloc_a = yes }
			NOT = { oe_end_is_leader_b = yes }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_subject = no
			NOT = { oe_end_is_bloc_a = yes }
			NOT = { oe_end_is_leader_b = yes }
			has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a
			country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_a
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = global_var:oe_end_leader_a }
		}
	}
	cooldown = { type = oe_end_act_join_hegemon_bloc_cd years = 5 }
	automation_tick = never
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		interaction_source_list = { situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = { add_to_list = source } }
		target_flag = recipient
		name = choose_situation
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { this = situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war situation_is_active = yes }
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			oe_end_assign_bloc_a = yes
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_end_hegemon_aligned_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
		}
		situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = {
			change_variable = { name = oe_end_balance add = 4 }
			clamp_variable = { name = oe_end_balance min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
		oe_end_score_5_theaters = yes
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = -10
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					NOT = { oe_end_has_bloc = yes }
					has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a
					country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_a
					OR = {
						is_allied_with = { target = global_var:oe_end_leader_a }
						opinion = { target = global_var:oe_end_leader_a value >= 50 }
					}
				}
			}
			add = 35
		}
	}
}

	type = situation

			NOT = { oe_end_is_bloc_leader = yes }

	allow = {

			is_subject = no
			at_war = no
			NOT = { oe_end_is_bloc_leader = yes }
			NOT = { oe_end_is_neutral = yes }
		}
	}
	cooldown = { type = oe_end_act_armed_neutrality_cd years = 6 }
	automation_tick = never
	ai_tick = monthly

		visible = { this = situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war situation_is_active = yes }
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			oe_end_assign_neutral = yes
			add_gold = { value = oe_end_gold_levee }
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_end_armed_neutrality_mod years = 8 mode = replace }
		}
		oe_end_score_5_theaters = yes
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = -12
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					NOT = { oe_end_has_bloc = yes }
					is_great_power = no
					has_ports = yes
				}
			}
			add = 24
		}
	}
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- Action 4: Intercontinental War Subsidy Chest ("Pitt's Gold")
oe_end_act_war_subsidy_chest = {
	type = situation
	show_message = no
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			OR = {
				oe_end_is_bloc_a = yes
				oe_end_is_bloc_b = yes
			}
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			gold >= oe_end_gold_subsidy
			OR = {
				oe_end_is_bloc_a = yes
				oe_end_is_bloc_b = yes
			}
		}
	}
	cooldown = { type = oe_end_act_war_subsidy_chest_cd years = 5 }
	automation_tick = never
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		interaction_source_list = { situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = { add_to_list = source } }
		target_flag = recipient
		name = choose_situation
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { this = situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war situation_is_active = yes }
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_gold = { value = oe_end_gold_subsidy multiply = -1 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_end_war_subsidy_mod years = 5 mode = replace }
			if = {
				limit = {
					oe_end_is_bloc_a = yes
					has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a
					country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_a
					NOT = { oe_end_is_leader_a = yes }
				}
				global_var:oe_end_leader_a = {
					add_gold = { value = scope:actor.oe_end_gold_subsidy }
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_end_war_subsidy_mod years = 5 mode = replace }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					oe_end_is_bloc_b = yes
					has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_b
					country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_b
					NOT = { oe_end_is_leader_b = yes }
				}
				global_var:oe_end_leader_b = {
					add_gold = { value = scope:actor.oe_end_gold_subsidy }
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_end_war_subsidy_mod years = 5 mode = replace }
				}
			}
		}
		situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:actor = { oe_end_is_bloc_a = yes } }
				change_variable = { name = oe_end_balance add = 5 }
			}
			else = {
				change_variable = { name = oe_end_balance add = -5 }
			}
			clamp_variable = { name = oe_end_balance min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
		oe_end_score_5_theaters = yes
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = 10
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { at_war = yes } }
			add = 12
		}
	}
}

		scope:actor = {
			add_gold = { value = oe_end_gold_levee multiply = -1 }
			add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
			add_war_exhaustion = war_exhaustion_mild_penalty
			add_manpower = {
				value = scope:actor.monthly_manpower
				multiply = 18

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- Action 6: Summon the World Peace Congress
oe_end_act_summon_peace_congress = {
	type = situation
	show_message = no
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = no
			OR = {
				oe_end_is_bloc_leader = yes
				is_great_power = yes
			}
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			gold >= oe_end_gold_congress
			oe_end_congress_action_ready = yes
		}
	}
	cooldown = { type = oe_end_act_summon_peace_congress_cd years = 5 }
	automation_tick = never
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		interaction_source_list = { situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = { add_to_list = source } }
		target_flag = recipient
		name = choose_situation
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { this = situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war situation_is_active = yes }
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_gold = { value = oe_end_gold_congress multiply = -1 }
			add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		}
		situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_end_balance var:oe_end_balance >= 75 }
				change_variable = { name = oe_end_balance add = 10 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_end_balance var:oe_end_balance <= 25 }
				change_variable = { name = oe_end_balance add = -10 }
			}
			else = {
				change_variable = { name = oe_end_exhaustion add = 20 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_end_exhaustion var:oe_end_exhaustion >= 85 }
					set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_congress_sealed value = 1 }
				}
			}
			clamp_variable = { name = oe_end_balance min = 0 max = 100 }
			clamp_variable = { name = oe_end_exhaustion min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
		oe_end_score_5_theaters = yes
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = 12
		if = {
			limit = { current_year >= 1825 }
			add = 25
		}
	}
}
